title: Classic Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Sauté garlic and onions in olive oil. Add canned tomatoes and simmer. Mix with pasta and top with basil.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Sauté garlic in butter. Pan-sear chicken until golden brown and cooked through. Serve hot.

title: Simple Grilled Cheese
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices. Place cheese in between. Toast on a pan until bread is golden and cheese is melted.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice fresh tomatoes and mozzarella. Layer them with basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.

title: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and parsley. Spread on sliced bread and bake until golden brown.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil. Add canned tomatoes and vegetable broth. Simmer for 15 minutes and blend. Stir in fresh basil.

title: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Sauté mushrooms and garlic in butter. Pour in heavy cream and simmer. Toss with cooked pasta and parsley.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Sauté sliced onions in butter until deeply caramelized. Add garlic and beef broth. Simmer for 30 minutes. Top with toasted bread and melted cheese.

title: Classic Cheese Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Pour into a heated buttery pan. Add cheese in the middle and fold when cooked.
